long_biography.plain_text:
Anton Prigodsky combined mine-construction work with civil-engineering studies at the Kharkiv Institute of Railway Transport Engineers. He rose from site foreman to senior management before heading the design and construction company Monolit, gaining practical experience in the industrial economy around Donetsk.

The shortage of dependable freight services for metal traders shaped his work with Lemtrans. He concentrated on strategy while entrusting daily operations to a management team. The business grew into a major private rail freight operator, subsequently becoming wholly owned by SCM, the industrial group controlled by Rinat Akhmetov.
